label: Quiet for adoptions, loud for everything else
from: Abbi and Lumina feature heavily · Harley asks her question
to: Two adoptions only — plus Sera, Livi, Alice and Nova's birthdays, a city-wide snowstorm, and Evie's certification arc
note: Ruled directly by Viraena. Abbi and Lumina are the only two Bryn takes in all arc, which makes it her quietest arc by intake and nothing like a quiet arc to live through. Sera, Livi, Alice and Nova celebrate birthdays. A snowstorm takes the whole city down. Evie's own arc runs the length of it, built around her electrician certifications and the Lucky Hammer. More beats are coming.
